digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 chunk and agent pool in plan review
propositions: With cold cache, submitting all chunks and agent futures concurrently to a 6-wide pool causes redundant cache-WRITE operations for the byte-identical plan-bearing system prefix across the first ~6 calls, inflating effective token usage from ideal 2.15N to ~7.9N (3.7x overhead).

The warm-then-fan-out pattern (proven for container bins) can be ported to the main pool: when estimated shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and chunk + agent criteria >= 2, run the first call serially to write the cache prefix, then fan out the remainder to the pool.
Non-systemic warm failures degrade gracefully to direct fan-out; systemic LLMUnavailableError on the warm call aborts the review.
The optimization is gated and verified via per-call cache metrics and call-ordering assertions to ensure single warm execution precedes pool submissions.
